youtube_full.title: A New Heart | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Ezekiel 36:26
youtube_full.description:
A New Heart: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Ezekiel 36:26.

Heavenly Father’s people were far from home. They had stopped listening to Him.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Willow the Warm.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: A New Heart
1:10 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Willow the Warm
1:48 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
3:00 Question time
3:19 Sweet dreams
3:37 More stories, the app and the paperback
